gadgets.sink: not a gadget -- the DEFENCE you must account for
gadgets.effect: prototype property and method access is denied by default, so {{x.constructor.constructor}} is dead; escapeExpression escapes & < > " ' ` = (space and / are NOT escaped, and = being escaped is what stops attribute injection); only a triple-stash, or an object whose toHTML is callable, emits raw
gadgets.trap: the lexer rejects NUL anywhere in the content, so a NUL-bearing file cannot be used as a template at all -- measured: NUL at start, middle or end all fail
